newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Trade minister says A$ at more accurate level.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Trade minister says A$ at more accurate level.

text.p: Australian Trade Minister Tim Fischer said on Wednesday the Australian dollar was now at a more accurate level.
When asked by reporters if the overnight fall in the Australian dollar meant it was now at a more accurate level, Fischer said: "I do."
Fischer said on Tuesday that he hoped the government's framework for lowering interest rates would lead to a more accurate value for the Australian dollar.
The Australian dollar tumbled 2-1/2 cents in offshore trade to a low of US$0.7855, compared to Tuesday's local close at US$0.8135/40.
Traders attributed the sell off to comments by former Reserve Bank of Australia governor Bernie Fraser and to expectations of another easing in monetary policy.
Fraser, who retired as the bank's governor in September, said after the close of local trading on Tuesday that the 50 basis point interest rate cut in early November should have been larger.
At 2.50 p.m. (0350 GMT) on Wednesday, the Australian dollar was trading around US$0.7985.
